fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects when a possible suspicious driver is being installed via pnputil.exe lolbin
fields.name: Suspicious Driver Install by pnputil.exe
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and ((tgt.process.cmdline contains "-i" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "/install" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "-a" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "/add-driver" or tgt.process.cmdline contains ".inf") and tgt.process.image.path contains "\\pnputil.exe"))
